dedupe_keys.name: dataset 14 aerpaw helikite spectrum measurements at lake wheeler site in august 2024

description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. The August 2024 Lake Wheeler campaign records approximately six hours of helikite spectrum measurements. The source describes a peak altitude of approximately 300 metres and spectrum sweeps up to 6 GHz. GPS logs accompany the SigMF recordings, and MATLAB processing results are described. The rural testbed observations support studies of spectrum occupancy and its variation with height and time. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. The linked Dryad release is registered under CC0 1.0 and is publicly accessible without charge. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Rural wireless spectrum planning. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
